notes: Windows revision 2: (1) self-contained .NET 8 publish (no separate .NET runtime step needed); (2) PFX export + upstream-update engine tools shipped under {app}\tools, exposed as `CertMateService.exe export-pfx` / `check-update` / `update` subcommands; (3) pre-flight checks, post-install validation, and installer logging in the Inno [Code] section. ProgramData is preserved on upgrade and on uninstall. This build (r2, 2026-11-11) fixes the 'Runtime error (at 9:1397): Type Mismatch' that fired on a clean Windows Server 2025 install: the Inno [Code] section's RegKeyExists call was passing the Pascal named constant HKLM (emitted as a 64-bit HKEY literal in Inno 7.1+) into a 32-bit HKEY-parametered function, which the runtime dispatch layer rejects with a type mismatch. The fix declares an explicit 32-bit integer constant HKLM_INT = $80000002 (HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE) and passes that instead. Upstream v2.55.1 application tree + embedded Python are NOT in this payload (skipped network step on the dev build host); this revision ships the self-contained .NET host + PFX/updater tools + docs + service registration + pre/post checks only. A full end-to-end build (with upstream source + Python 3.12 embeddable staged under {app}\app and {app}\python) requires running Build-Release.ps1 on a networked build host.
